_comment: Buzz KO fleet profile. One entry per Mac; scripts read this instead of hard-coding hosts, routes, volumes, keys or roles. Roles: build (may compile; owner rule: M5 Mac Studios only), release (holds signing/notary/updater secrets: the one release build host), notify (posts Buzz notices), install (gets Buzz KO). always_on: an unreachable device is an incident. buzz_ko_account: the account the device's Buzz KO runs as (devices without one get no Buzz KO). launch_agent + buzz_ko_secret: the account key is injected from that principal-secrets-mono file by a LaunchAgent rendered from ko/launch-agent.plist.tmpl. Jobs refuse to start below internal_min_free_gb and keep temp files and download caches under <work_root>/cache. secrets_clone: the principal-secrets-mono clone each device keeps synced (own-device run); app_dir: the Buzz KO checkout under a build device's work_root.

m5m1.notes: tmux server is GUI-domain and stalls on /Volumes/Build; run remote jobs with ssh + nohup

m5m2.notes: no Buzz KO and no secret values here (principal-secrets-mono decision 0016)
